I realized that the reason Jevil is behind bars is because he’s the joker card and no one knows how to use it so they just put it back in the box or never take it out to begin with, believing it’s insane and incomprehensible

Edit: So there’s this card game (I forgot the name) but Toby definitely took inspiration from it. So basically how it works is that the whole game your fighting against the royals with all the other cards and every suit has it’s own special ability, hearts replenish the draw pile, diamonds replenish your hand, clubs reduce the damage of the current royal, spades double damage making them the strongest, however when fighting a royal of the same suit the ability cancels out. With one exception, the Joker. The Joker can use any ability and it can’t be cancelled, meaning it can do anything and is the strongest. Also you may have noticed that this is a battle game, with heath and damage, making it a numbers’ game. But the Joker card can only exist in the game if more than two people are playing making it imprisoned in a way. Also if you assume that Asriel and Dess played this game and that Seam is Asriel’s plush, then one could imagine a scenario where Asriel wanted an advantage of sorts, pretending that Seam is another player, allowing them to use the Joker card, which is why Seam has a piece of the key to unlock the Joker and knows where the others are. And perhaps Asriel being a kid justifies having Seam as another player by saying that they’re friends with the Joker

Edit Edit: the ability thing with the Joker is how Jevil can use hearts, spades, diamonds, and clubs all at once. Also the game is called Regicide

stories.author: @priyanshukatuwal
stories.text:
Thinking of playing this game again some time. I was extremely excited for new chapters. Before one week of this game's release date, I hurried and finished the first two chapters to freshen my memory of the story and the game. Then when the chapter came out, I downloaded the game but didn't do anything for some time. I stopped browsing Deltarune content in social medias to prevent spoilers. After a few days, I finally got the time to play Chapter 3, which was okay as far as I can remember. But I liked the creator did experimented with the game and gave something new like that game inside game thing. I liked the ending of that chapter. 

I immediately started Chapter 4 to continue the story, I was at the edge of my seat. I played for 1-2 hours. Then, I waited till tomorrow and played for some time again. But I was itching to play more but I couldn't, since I didn't have time to play it for myself. So I opened YouTube and just started watching spoilers because I wanted to know what happens next in the story. It was amazing experience, Chapter 4 blew my mind. The final boss fight was really really cool. I like the friendship of Kris and Susie. 

I kinda stopped after that, I stopped loving playing games. It just didn't hit the same anymore, Deltarune reignited the flame but the flame didn't last long. I didn't bother to replay the game and find new secrets and contents. I have all the secret bosses, dialogues to encounter myself. It seems like I didn't do justice to this game. I have some very fun memories with Undertale and Deltarune (CH 1+2) games, so it really sucks that I just don't have the energy to enjoy these games like I want to.

stories.author: @PreStalnic
stories.text:
This is the BGM for the PS4 theme for Undertale.

I remember where I was when I first heard this. I played it on loop for hours, sitting in my chair, centered to my TV. It was 2018. I had been processing a lot of emotions. A lot of stress. A lot of pain. This song did something to me. The black background with the white outlines of a town. I couldn't explain why I just started sobbing in my room. The night sky only lit by my TV screen. I lost so many people in my life to death, break-ups, and just moving on. The pain that never gets resolved. All you can do is press forward. Be better not for others, but yourself. 

Never give up. 

Fight. 

Continue.

stories.author: @MarchEridanOfficial
stories.text:
EDIT 2: this old theory is kind of wrong.

Had a horrifying theory. The songs name is referencing the actual "girl next door" trope, in which typically a protagonist must make a choice between dating a new and typically "bad/rebellious" girl or the sweet childhood friend. Noelle is obviously the girl next door and old childhood friend to Kris, while Susie is the new and "bad/rebellious" girl. In chapter 4, people have been speculating that the girl in the prophecy isn't actually Susie, but Noelle. However, what if it could be either of them and we make the choice as to who the girl in the prophecy is. Where in the normal route it's Susie, but in the weird route, it's Noelle. In the weird route, there is lots of symbolism relating to marriage and love (rings, "We're something else"), which implies that we're forcing Noelle and Kris into a relationship. Additionally,  in the weird route, Susie gets pushed aside in some scenes for a greater emphasis put onto Noelle. So, in the weird route, we essentially fulfill the "Girl Next Door" trope by turning Noelle into the girl in the prophecy.

Edit 1: Ok so the prophecies of "The second hero, the girl with hope crossed on her heart" and "At last was the girl" are likely not referring to the same person, with the latter definitely being Susie as in the files its sprite is literally called "prophecy rude buster" or something like that. So, Susie is definitely in the prophecy, but "the girl with hope crossed on her heart" is left vague, but it's probably Noelle or Dess. So we likely aren't replacing Susie with Noelle in the weird route, but she's still getting sidelined in the narrative. Everything else still works fine in this theory though.

stories.author: @tinycatcoven
stories.text:
I figured this would be the best place to share this, so: 
Undertale/Deltarune has changed my life for the better. These games have ignited a passion that I haven't felt in so long, especially after starting university and feeling anxious and lost. I have never felt so drawn in by a game in my life--I actually never felt that games were "for me" before I finally decided to play Undertale out of the blue about a month ago! These games reignited my passion for music, and in the past few weeks I started playing piano again after a hiatus of nearly a year, and I just started learning to play the guitar! I don't plan on slowing down until I've mastered multiple Undertale/Deltarune songs! 
I just think these games are so deeply enjoyable, everything about them. When facing struggles in my personal life,  and all around me, I find these games to be the perfect tool for a bit of escapism. Their characters draw me in the most; in an environment where everything seems to be becoming increasingly less human, the stories that Toby Fox and his crew have created together, feel so, so, real. Every bit of these games has so much character, so much intention and time put into them! 

I'm a bit embarrassed to comment this so I'm hoping it gets buried. I just needed a place to get this out!

stories.author: @AypuoH
stories.text:
It would definitely sound strange, but tonight this melody probably saved my life (Or at least mental health), and from the very Silksong OST itself.
I was lying with fever and convulsions, which started suddenly, in a mere minutes. It was scary and I was trying to calm down, but there was a Silksong's final boss track, Lost Lace, stuck in my head, and let's say it's not a calming melody, it's a hecking tragedy apotheosis. Don't get me wrong, it's a real masterpiece, but the only thing that you can think of it when you're hearing it on the loop in your own head while lying with fever is "I would REALLY prefer something more calmer".
And I'm actually susceptible to the music's influence, and my health often depends on my mood. Well, maybe not THAT much, but again, I was in fever and couldn't think properly.
So, I've tried to shoo it away with any other thought, but I couldn't turn my PC on or get to my phone to turn on some calm music for myself, I couldn't even really move at the time, my temperature was about 40 degrees Celsius, so all I've got is obsessive thoughts that something bad is going to happen if I don't manage to change this song in my head to something, anything else. 
Since I've just ended playing Silksong and liked it very much, I mentally tried all the other, more calmer OSTs from it, but they quickly brought me back to square one.
Then, after a few minutes of tries, I remembered about my other favorite game, Deltarune, and the first OST from it that I thought of, that I remembered perfectly, since I once tried to learn how to play it on piano, was this one. It managed to replace Lost Lace instantly, and brought much brighter thoughts with it. After that, convulsions quickly stopped and I've finally managed to go and grab the antipyretics and other medicines. Half an hour later they took effect and I've managed to sleep, and I'm pretty sure My Castle Town played in my head all night, bringing me a peaceful dreams. Today I'm feeling much better. Well, maybe it will change later, I don't know, but what I certainly know is that this melody won't leave me even at the darkest hour, soothing my mind when it's needed.
So, Thank You, Toby Fox, for this astonishing music, that can heal the body and mind.

stories.author: @AstralBirthVoid0
stories.text:
This EXACT moment when A Cyber's World? starts playing, that you fall down, the bullets go crazy for a few seconds and at the same time the beat drops you get to see the background of cyber field in all its glory...
This is one of the most memorable moment yet. It was perfectly crafted.

Chapter 2 was the first time I've discovered in live, at the same time than everyone, one of Tricky Box's work.
At the time, Deltarune was only the first chapter and people were not crazy about it yet.
But this moment... the moment the beat drops, I think it's the exact instant that I, as many, realized that yes, the Chapter 2 is here.
The moment we realized this was all much bigger than what we expected.
And the moment we all started going crazy on this game.

I understand people prefering to only play Deltarune is out, but this is for this type of thing (and references to Asgore driving his truck with a friend inside him) that I think discovering them this way is an unforgettable and irreplacable experience.

I've watched a 10 hour french stream that ended it in one go by my favorite youtuber, who did a lot of Undertale stuff before, in ×1.5 speed. It was a Tuesday night, before an half day of school, I could use my tablet in secret during the night. I finished it at around 6 AM.

I can't put into words how incredible it all was.
This is the kind of experienced I'd wish to relive for the first time all over again.

stories.text:
* Ribbit, ribbit.
* (I'm an old froggit.)
* (The humans that fell down before you were all different people.)
* (Some were kind, some were scared, some were brave...)
* (Some tried to fight, some tried to run away...)
* _(Some stayed with the woman for a long, long time.)_

In the Undertale 10th anniversary stream, the Toy Knife was relocated to an accessible version of Home, with the music playing there containing the leitmotif of this song, which is commonly considered to be Kris's own theme.

Interestingly, comments in the code of the Undertale Demo imply that the Toy Knife was originally called the "Soul Knife". The kris is a Javanese dagger, which are considered almost alive because they may be vessels of spirits, thus literally being "Soul Knives".

Every time we've seen a monster in the Dark World, they have consistently had their hues shifted to be lighter than in the Light World, potentially tying into monster souls being white—This even extends to Gerson, since he is reincarnated as a darkner in Chapter 4. However, Kris, a human, turns _cyan_ in the Dark World, instead of red, the color of our soul.

Aqua, who is oddly the only plantner to hold more than one color in her design (having both light blue and red), is a parallel to the patience human as you'd expect, but also mimics Kris, in both appearance and what we know Kris was like when they were younger.



Hmmm... I wonder who Kris's Undertale counterpart was...

stories.author: @DementedDuskull
stories.text: Remember when Ralsei was dressed up as a butler? Yeah...turns out, that was actually some rather depressing symbolism... Ralsei is of the mindset that he isn't real, and so puts the needs of the Lightners far above his own - he bakes them cake, but doesn't eat it himself; he gives them their own rooms, but leaves his own empty; he worries about how the adventure will personally affect them while repressing his own thoughts and feelings. He feels he is merely a butler, there to serve his masters and not himself. This is why it's important that Susie makes such a big deal about clearing up to him that he isn't their servant, but their friend.

stories.author: @Agote_001
stories.text:
For me Berdly is unironically the best character in Deltarune. 
At first even if he is extremely funny you can see he is flawed, he is egocentric, annoying, pretty unaware and even dumb despite he saying he was so smart.

But after this scene everything changes, he reveals that he just has a huge inferiority complex, no one remembered his name, and the first time he ever got attention and validation was too much for him, adopting being the "gifted and smart kid" as his whole personality as a defense mechanism for not hating himself and feel forgotten.
Noelle says that he is "good when they are alone" showing that despite acting like he does he is actually a good friend that loves the person that always helped him to not be forgotten and mistreated again. We can see more of this in Snowgrave, he is actually the hero of the story, the only one that stands up to us, really caring for Noelle, showing again that his ridiculous personality is mostly an act for him to feel safe and important.
What people ignore is that he also shows all this good traits in the normal route as well, he opens himself to us, he drops his pride of thinking that everyone else is dumber than him and asks for our help to save Noelle, and at the end he gets help from everyone and without his help defeating Queen would be 100% impossible, he is the MVP of chapter 2. 
He has it all; amazing theme, great design, funny, unique personality, character development, interesting and relatable backstory.

Also, I personally relate a lot to him, during my entire first highschool year I was also seen as the weird kid with no friends that everyone disliked just for that. But then next year I dont remember why someone saw my grades, they were great. People started to praise me for the first time in my life, they started to ask for my help, i helped them, and I started acting like the smart kid as well feeling as the "second teacher", also being afraid of failing one day and lose the reputation that I worked so hard to achieve. I understand Berdly perfectly, I wish more people did, because he is a pretty hated character sadly.

I love Berdly, and I really hope to see more of him in next chapters. Also Im a _gamer_ as well and blue is my favourite color.

stories.author: @Rubberman202
stories.text:
So I watched this streamer who played Deltarune Chapter 2, and she ended up really sympathizing with Berdly in this moment. To her, even if Noelle was helping Berdly, that only goes so far, some of it had to have came from Berdly himself. She then explained how there's this perception that people either "have it", whether that be intelligence, talent, or what have you, or they don't, and it's a perception she doesn't care for, since anyone is capable of being good at something so long as they practice and have the right mindset. To her, Berdly could not be considered the smartest student in class if Noelle was literally doing all the work for him...

...Even though I'm fairly certain that's not what Toby intended to convey with Berdly's character, particularly after playing chapter 4. Either that, or his inflated ego has caused him to get lazy and increasingly reliant of Noelle's help. Either way, I feel like both that streamer and I are in the minority of people who actually sympathize with Berdly after this moment. Feels more like people still hate Berdly after this reveal, some even more so actually. I don't know, regardless of how much of the actual work he does nowadays to be the smartest, I don't blame him for desperately wanting to keep this reputation for being the smartest if it used to be that no one would even remember his name when he was younger. At least now people respect him, if only on a surface level. He just needs to be a bit more... self-aware, and aware of how others perceive him. Something he's REALLY bad at, as it turns out.

stories.author: @The_McRib_Is_Back
stories.text:
TLDR; If Rouxls manipulated his stats to go all out, he’d easily be a contender for strongest Darkner.

Calling it now: with all the genre shifts in this chapter (turn-based combat, 2D platforming, pseudo–Ace Attorney vibes, Metroidvania, dating-sim energy from Mew Mew, etc.), plus Flowery’s “we don’t have to follow your silly little rules” quote, it could be foreshadowing that Rouxls is being plausibly set up to completely change the game’s style multiple times in a future fight.

I think Toby is using these gimmicks throughout the Dark Worlds as tutorial mechanics for the upcoming fight, similar to how the TP restriction in the Jackenstein fight and the climbing sections in Chapter 4 were foreshadowing for the Titan fight. Gerson also steps in to guide Susie toward an internal solution, mirroring how the Titan is defeated by pivoting their approach rather than simply overpowering it.

We already get hints as early as Chapter 3: Tenna’s special win conditions, his physical challenges, and Tenna rapidly changing channels at the end to throw you off. Rouxls breaks the traditional battle methods by forcing Lanino and Elnina into a “Battle Throuple” and using a laser pointer (It’s mostly a gag, but still). He restricts the Fun Gang by removing options other than ACTing, and is only defeated due to Lancer’s shenanigans that help them win on a technicality. 

Lancer’s act counts since they’re still ACTing, even if it’s not an act they can perform normally, just like how the Titan is defeated by a technicality. It’s defeated by a "fountain sealing" instead of being beaten head on. Winning on a technicality or "going between the lines" as Gerson would say, is the only way someone like Roulxs could be defeated if he made himself immune to standard attacks or made it impossible to defend yourself.

—
I don’t think Toby will make Rouxls a truly serious antagonist like King or the Knight, but he’s the only Darkner we’ve seen so far other than Ralsei who can travel through Dark Worlds and has potential to become like Flowery. For him, stats don’t have to be real; he can bend the rules to make them real, unlike Flowery, who was largely bluffing. Flowery couldn’t actually change his stats, but… a Roulxs Kaard can. Roulxs could genuinely be the Darkner version of Undyne the Undying if Toby wanted him to be.

Edit: 
Another thing I found interesting as I thought about it was the fact that Roulxs also has things in common with secret bosses. 

Roulxs has (singular as of writing) voice line(s) like Jevil, Spamton, Gerson, and Mew Mew, and has a very obvious speech quirk in the form of old timey English. His theme is confirmed to be diegetic, and considering Toby has been putting the motif in more songs that don’t make sense at face value (looking at you, "Inappropriate Recycling") I wouldn’t put it past Toby to add it to a future Roulxs theme if he’s plot relevant. 

Roulxs also seems to want to be “free” in his own way. Since Chapter 1, he’s been fighting against his own irrelevancy and his desire to be important as the “right hand man” of the main antagonist, which is a goal he hasn’t yet achieved, which could be solved by him getting one final fight. 

To further add on to that, Toby even has a scrapped theme literally called "Epic Roulxs Battle" that was made all the way back in Chapter 1 (If you don’t believe me just look it up it’s on YouTube). There’s no way Toby isn’t planning SOMETHING with him.

AND, if you look closely in Chapter 2, he even looks like pirate Gaster- TLDR; If Rouxls manipulated his stats to go all out-…

stories.author: @nina.k9
stories.text:
This track makes me, a 27 year old, look back at my 17 year old self, knowing everything I know now. A kid who was closeted and confused, trying to survive academic life with undiagnosed ADHD, with an abusive dad waiting at home. I am thinking about her and about so many other kids who woke up feeling like whatever that was happening to them was their fault. And now I think what would have happened if my 17 year old self were to disappear like poor Dess did. What if she died at 17, what if my life ended then and there. At that age everything I did, the exams I were studying, friendships I were chasing, they were all affected by my neurodivergency. I had no idea I was swimming against a current while everyone else had no issue navigating it. I was depressed, and I often wished for a button I could press to just... not exist. Not to die, death seemed too violent, but to be erased from reality. It's kinda haunting looking back at it now. 

If my life ended at 17 it would've been heartbreaking, now I can see that. Because this past decade my dad passed away (and yes, it was complicated - I both mourned him and was relieved by his absence; I loved him and I hated him), I came out as gay, I left the religion I was forced to participate in, and I am about to go through my DIVA-5 evaluation so my ADHD can get appropriately recognised as a learning disability. And I am in med school!! It's kicking my ass but once I get my drug regimen in order I can learn to live with my ADHD, not as something that needs to be "fixed", as an elementary part of myself. Hearing this track, seeing Dess' abandoned room... it's a gut punch. It makes me want to give my 17 year old self a hug. 

If a teen ever reads this, especially a struggling one: adults keep saying "it gets better" but I don't like that phrase. It implies you are bound to get past your teenage years anyway, that it's no big deal in the long run. That's not true. You are SURVIVING teenagehood right now. Lots of kids don't make it. Lots of teens stay teens forever. What I can say is: once you survive these years you will realise that it was never because of you. Whatever you went through, it was not your fault, it had nothing to do with what kind of a person you are. Teenage years are hard because you depend on ADULTS to show you guidance, and many adults do not do it. They don't care enough to spot obviously struggling neurodivergent kids, queer kids, kids of colour who go through institutionalised racism, kids who deal with bullying and/or abuse at home. So it's not you kiddo. "It gets better" means if you are not too broken by the end of your childhood, you can take control of your own life. Bruised badly but standing. You can see for yourself that surviving teenagehood was worth it, because YOU are worth it. That it would be a tragedy if you were to disappear.

When I was at my lowest point, I felt like I was walking aimlessly without anyone to have my back. It was the result of years believing that my worth was decided by my academic results, and one small failure led me to believe I was a failure. 
This song was my comfort during that time, partly because it was relatively new and it just stuck with me. 

I got a lot better and became emotionally stronger, however this song reminds me of that little girl who felt abandoned by the world, that found comfort in this

stories.author: @leafy_vert
stories.text:
I've been in a long-distance relationship since 2021. That year, episode 2 of Deltarune came out, we played it, and I asked him if we'd ever have a moment like that together, and he said yes. After almost five years together, we finally met in person, and my idea was to take him to an amusement park, but I didn't have enough money. However, my mom said she'd pay for the ticket, so we went. Although most rides didn't allow personal belongings, this one did, and my partner had the idea to play this soundtrack on the Ferris wheel while we watched the sunset. Without a doubt, it was the most romantic moment of my life.
Edit (14/02/26): It's only been a month since that date; I remember it like it was yesterday. If all goes well, the distance will end in two years.

stories.text:
KILLER QUEEN: BITES THE DUST



My name is Yoshikage Kira. I'm 33 years old. My house is in the northeast section of Morioh, where all the villas are, and I am not married. I work as an employee for the Kame Yu department stores, and I get home every day by 8 PM at the latest. I don't smoke, but I occasionally drink. I'm in bed by 11 PM, and make sure I get eight hours of sleep, no matter what. After having a glass of warm milk and doing about twenty minutes of stretches before going to bed, I usually have no problems sleeping until morning. Just like a baby, I wake up without any fatigue or stress in the morning. I was told there were no issues at my last check-up. I'm trying to explain that I'm a person who wishes to live a very quiet life. I take care not to trouble myself with any enemies, like winning and losing, that would cause me to lose sleep at night. That is how I deal with society, and I know that is what brings me happiness. Although, if I were to fight I wouldn't lose to anyone.



Hands.

stories.author: @YT-Masonius
stories.text:
>“The Dark Truth” is the motif of “Your Best Nightmare”
>Has a remix in Chapter 4 when you struggle against the Knight
>Digital Roots + Bit Roots are the “Your Best Nightmare” motif
>Black Knife starts with “Burn in Despair”
>The Knight’s final attack is identical to the “God of Hyperdeath” attack, also shoots exploding stars
>Slowing down and isolating "snd_knight_pulse.wav" is the talking sound of Asriel
>The Knight and Asriel both leave after-affect trails in their boss fights
>Both shoot beams of light out of their hands 
>One titan spawn attack is identical to Omega Flowey's chomping mouth attack
>GLACEIR contains motif of the Yellow soul's theme in Omega Flowey fight
>Mannerisms like poses and laughs are very similar, and perfectly mimic Kris’s movements
>Is described to be a large person twice, is possibly around Asgore’s size
>Undertale Anniversary stream showed concept of “Asriel’s bat” weapon
>Kris refuses to let the player see Asriel’s search history in Chapter 2, “You have the feeling you wouldn’t learn anything.”
>Checking the Knight says “But Kris couldn’t learn anything.”
>Opening the door says “You opened the door with your eyes closed. You saw nothing.”
>Opening the closet door in the church says “You turned the doorknob. You don’t do anything else.”
>Every character in Undertale/Deltarune mirror each other’s developments and personalities to some extent like Asgore and Toriel’s divorce, Undyne and Alphys getting closer, Bratty and Catty becoming friends, etc
>Gerson describes the prophecy in Undertale: “Legend has it, an ‘angel’ who has seen the surface will descend from above and bring us freedom.”
>The ‘freedom motif’ is given to all characters who have a ShadowCrystal, which is from the Knight, and presumably manipulates darkners into going insane
>Identity of the angel in Deltarune’s prophecy is still unknown, though Asriel fulfilled the role in Undertale even sporting angel wings
>The Knight is seen crying, no one mentions it or knows why
>Dess is mourned by many people, but no one was as close to her as Asriel, conveniently absent from the plot
>Dess has already been seen outside the Knight, calling from the code in each chapter’s unused dialogue, and pressing against Kris’s hand when trying to backtrack after seeing the final prophecy accompanied with a faint guitar string sound
>Gerson is also knowledgeable of the prophecy in Deltarune, stating "Stories can be rewritten; they can be changed. That's what I believe."
>Has changed the prophecy for his own book "Lord of the Hammer", and is later rewritten again for Dragon Blazers, which alters elements but generally retells the same story
>Undertale and Deltarune are anagrams of each other, and described in the Ch3/4 trailer as "Undertale's parallel story"

Yeah probably just a coincidence 🙃

stories.author: @invalid_user_handle
stories.text:
I remember people thinking that Spamton's dialogue in the alternate route's fight didn't have much significance to future chapters... I think people were just blind. Here, watch.
"BUT DON'T BLAME ME, *_WHEN YOU'RE [Crying] IN A [Broken Home],_* WISHING YOU LET YOUR OLD PAL SPAMTON [Kill You]"
That one doesn't need explanation, does it?
"THE [Voice] RUNS OUT EVENTUALLY. *_YOUR [Voice], THEIR [Voice],UNTIL YOU REALIZE THAT YOU ARE ALL ALONE."_*
That voice being us, obviously. Who else would it be? 
"WHAT!? YOU'RE CALLING FRIENDS!? YOU THINK YOU CAN BEAT ME WITH YOUR FRIENDS' [Magic]!? GO AHEAD, [Kid]... *_CALL ALL YOU WANT! NO ONE WILL EVER PICK UP"_*
Kris's phone. That phone never had anyone call it, yet it still speaks. A voice you hear, only while far away... never when you dial it and bring it to your ear. Then it's just garbage noise.
"THERE WILL BE NO MORE [Miracles], NO MORE [Magic]. *_YOU LOST IT WHEN YOU TRIED TO SEE TOO FAR... YOU LOST IT..."_*
In the end, our detour may prevent a terrible tragedy. But, in the process, it shall cause one of it's own. Is it worth it?
"YOU MAKE ME [Sick]! *_MUTTERING YOUR [Lost Friends] NAMES AT THE BOTTOM OF A [Dumpster]! NO ONE'S GONNA HELP YOU!!!_* GET THAT THROUGH YOUR [Beautiful Head], YOU LITTLE [Worm]!"
Our actions push away those around Kris. It becomes easier to hurt others, and your emotions deaden so they cannot hurt you. It shall reach a point that even Kris will reject us, and we will be alone.
Only then shall we, the Angel from Heaven Above, claim our desire. It was woven into the very prophecy, after all... the one that we are destined to break apart for our own gain.

Remember, Spamton always addresses Kris directly in his _regular_ dialogue. Never uses the word 'you' anywhere over there. But here? Uses it all the time, and much like the [Hyperlink Blocked], it's clear the intention behind each of them is different, addressing between you and Kris. Somehow, this wasn't spotted sooner, even though it feels so obvious, doesn't it?

I wrote this just before chapter 3 and 4 came out:
This song is called "Until Next Time."
It's not the best OST, nor my favorite. But it does have a special place "inside me"...
I started playing deltarune from chapter 2 in 2021, before that I've only heard about it, and I really loved it, that's why I'm here, writing this.
When I finished deltarune, this was the last thing I heard, I want to remember two things from this song: until next time, don't forget.
Like many of us, I've stayed, not forgotten, and will wait patiently until a new chapter comes out (until next time). And here we are.
That's why I like this song so much. I feel like it represents me to a certain extent, it represents the long wait we've had. The hope and time I've put into this game despite having almost no new content in four years. That's why I want to say it right away: Deltarune tomorrow

I also want to point out something I read in these comments: you can't play Chapter 2 for the first time again...

stories.author: @Tam33m
stories.text:
i just figured it out.... 


This is based on Don't Forget (meaning let it stay in your memory)

This song is skipping around... like a dying old disc. Discs are a form of long-term memory.

As you get older, only the core details are intelligible. This song represents the fact that 
- you know that it's a song (enough for the melody)
- there is singing, hence the unintelligible singing in the beginning) 

but you only remember the core words, hence the only lyrics being "when the light is running low", "don't forget" (interestingly incomplete... and repeating it many _many_ times in an attempt to complete it (...is it not that important?)... or in a desperate attempt to signal that it's very important), and "I'm with you in the dark".


This song is on track to contrast with Don't Forget... something to keep in mind, or perhaps i could say.... don't forget.

This song brought me out of an emotional slump (L O N G story).
But chapter 3 came out, and because my husband and I were about to get on a plane, we decided to sleep the night in a hotel (which you can really call a hotel). Before booting up the game, I mostly just wanted to get through the next 2 days. I knew the soundtrack would be amazing, just didn't know what it'd be quite like.
After Tenna's intro, I must have been dancing to this for like 10 minutes because my husband could only hear me shuffling around in my seat, wondering what the hell was going on.

Thank you Tenna, you helped me get through an entire week.

Here’s a dumb crack-theory that I made a while ago. 
(Please, don’t really this seriously, I made this with little confidence.)


What if Tenna is actually the real Mike?

It sounds stupid, and it sounds like I’m going back into Chapter 2 era theories, but listen.


What if “Mike” is actually Tenna’s “Pre-Doomed-Yaoi-Sona”?

What if his full name is actually “Mike ‘Ant’ Tenna?”

And the reason why he hired “Mike(s)” was because he wanted to reminisce of who he used to be before him and Spamton’s divorce.
What if he was so ashamed of himself that he doesn’t even go by his first name anymore, and refers to “Mike” like he’s a separate person?

Maybe this is why Green Pippins thought of “Mike” being “Tennas Alter-Ego” or “Imaginary Friend”.


Or maybe I’m just insane

stories.author: @coldcallerloopy
stories.text: My only, and I do mean ONLY complaint with Deltarune is primarily in this cooking minigame. Z in games is always the action for confirmation, or jumping, and X is for secondary actions and firing. So why the hell is Z now shoot (this applies to yellow soul too in Spamton's fight) and X jump in the cooking minigame. This is weirdly paradoxical to how any video game ever that uses Z and X goes, Shovel Knight, Cave Story, Megaman, and so on all use Z for jump and X for fire, so why is it reversed? I wouldn't mind if there was a specific keybind for "minigames" so I could reverse this but I would be forced to swap the Z/X used in the normal game. It just feels wrong to me. Toby we perfect the wheel years ago you don't gotta fix that one.

For anyone else looking to get T-rank in the Susiezilla minigame:
The threshold is 800
The game spawns 7 regular guys first before throwing a ranged one at ya. The range guys give 5 points each, and it spawns 6 ranged ones shortly after. They always spawn at the right first, so SPAWN CAMP THEM NOW!!!!
Bonus Rounds normally are a pain (at least for me) but you can skip them by Taking No Damage. Doing this gives you 99 points
After 3 dozers come you also get 12 ranged shadowguys. I spawn camped the first 3 (they're on the right, remember that) and rebounded the other 3's tenna balls (some of them will hit the others)

Also, for the boss, don't bother attacking the other guys when it's at least 70% charged, and get rid of the Dozers *immediately*. It's still a pain tho sooo

I already know this song is gonna mean a lot to me.
I’m playing deltarune right now and I just saved and left my room to grab a bite and use the bathroom. And the whole time I could just hear my mom sobbing uncontrollably from my parents room. I’m not at all used to seeing her like this, but things haven’t been going well at home or work lately.
I head back to my room and my mind starts racing, imagining all the different things that could have happened to cause her to react like this. 
I still don’t know whether it was something my sister said or she got fired or nothing at all.
But deltarune was running, playing this song throughout the house and my room, keeping my mind at ease throughout the whole thing, even as I’m writing this. 
I sincerely hope the creators of stuff like this don’t underestimate how much their work can impact a random person in a random place. My night would’ve been a whole lot worse right now if it wasn’t for deltarune. Thank you Toby <3

It just feels so personal and intimate (similar to Ferris Wheel from Ch2, but I like this take more), like you've stepped away from a crowd and now are alone on the beach; just you, your thoughts and the waves around you. 
Its so wonderful, chill and soft, yet sings most strongly a bittersweet and sombre tone that radiates throughout the whole track that I can't help but fall in love with just that little bit. A time and memory long forgotten, brought temporarily to linger in the present, before being forgotten again with time, new memories and priorities... just like the waves sweeping away footprints in the sand, just like the nostalgia an old memory brings

stories.author: @differentplace2955
stories.text:
I think this is my favorite song from the third chapter, it carries so much emotion behind it; it's comforting yet heartbreaking. In the game, I always stop to look at the wall of frosted TVs for a while to listen to it. One of those TVs reminds me of my childhood CRT. And after telling this story to my friend, he responded that Toby based Tenna on my TV XD, so I thought I would sort of memorialize it and this memory in here (brace yourself, it's going to be a long one)

So, back when I was a little brat, I had a CRT TV, you know, I spent a few years with it, basically my whole childhood. I watched cartoons on it that my mom had pirated for me. Having my own TV was awesome; I could stay up late watching movies and spilling cocoa on the couch XD. I loved that thing. You could never fully clean it because the casing texture was rough; it had those RCA jacks for audio and video and that indent with a screw on top,  and yeah, I used to stick magnets to it because it made cool colors appear XD. But you know how it is—CRT TVs are fucking huge. Eventually, I used it less and wanted a shelf for random junk, and Mom wanted to get rid of it. So, on a December night—I don't remember exactly, but it was heavily snowing—we hauled it outside. I said my goodbye to it and all that, but I was still really torn thinking about my decision when I saw some random guy taking it away through the window; I bawled my eyes out. But since I was just a kid, I didn't know what to do. And later, that shelf just got cluttered with completely useless stuff from the basement—stuff that gathers just as much dust as that TV did—and it really wasn't worth the trauma or the loss of the TV. I know it sounds silly, but it was a weirdly tragic moment of my childhood with the dark and snow and all. I sometimes think about my TV and where it is and regret my decision. 

 I have only told this story to my friend, but I think my CRT deserved to be remembered even by strangers. Also, I have been paying for my doings with fighting the knight in chp.3 for a couple of days now and having an absolutely miserable time XD. I'm going to get him someday.

stories.author: @endro555
stories.text:
today as of writing this i've just turned 19 years old. i decided to go to a childhood mall today and it kinda made me sad? not in a way that ruins my day but its like. bittersweet. melancholic?
the place i went first was the toys R us - i fondly remember it being brightly lit, shelves stocked sky high, and full of all kinds of fun stuff to lose yourself in. fast forward about 10 years (nowadays), and its.. clearly gone through a lot. the lights are dim, theres not as much stock as there used to be, and everything felt so... desperate, in a way? like they were trying to get everything out of it as they could even though its outlived itself
the lego was up at the front instead of in its own huge aisle, feeling like it was telling you to just buy it and leave. the video game section was gone entirely and replaced with some other store, and all of the aisles that used to be sorted nicely were all seemingly mashed together into one small aisle.
it really reminded me of chapter 3 - mainly with tenna and his character. the desperation to stay relevant, holding on to the past so dearly and not wanting to let go of it, and the fear of being forgotten and thrown away. in fact, this track was ringing in my head as i wandered around the place. 
regardless, the entire vibe of the store felt like it..  didn't want to go. that it didn't want to be replaced by something new. it wanted to keep the dream alive but unfortunately just.. got too old and couldn't keep up.
i've had very nice memories of this place that i cherish dearly. i remember buying hero factory sets from the lego aisle. discovering skylanders for the first time in the video game section and browsing the gigantic wall of them. looking at the expensive transformers toys next to the angry birds telepods. 
it's quite sad to see it coming to its inevitable end. it will forever hold a special place in my heart as the toy store that made me who i am today - and i hope that it can still create more happy memories with the new generation despite how old it is.

stories.text: This song reminds me of that feeling after childhood family gatherings. Sometimes I'd feel anxious over them but I'd always end up having fun. The house was filled with light and laughter and talking. Playing, running with my cousins.. the clanking of silverware, the sound of the tv. One thing was certain, it would all be over soon. No matter how fun, it always ended. We would say our goodbyes and they'd leave. The door shut behind them. The house felt empty, the sight of dirty dishes and an empty couch. An empty table, the mess we'd left behind. Silence. It was such a bittersweet feeling. The feeling after the fun was had, when all that's left behind is the lonely memory. Growing up, and seeing each other less and less. It hurts in the same particular way this song does, and knowing the story behind the world it plays in, it feels almost poetic.

stories.author: @Bramble_Juice
stories.text:
It's really interesting how this song is such a slow, melancholic callback to the "Uwa!!" songs from Undertale. Because if you can remember, one of those songs is called "Uwa!! So Holiday♫"... And with how much the Holiday family (along with the Dreemurr family) is tied into the emotional core of Chapter 3's plot, as well as the overarching story, it's so clear to me that this song is directly connected to the Holidays. Especially when considering its title mentioning snow, and the fact that it plays in the room where you enter "12/25" as the code to unlock the parental lock door that was originally put in place to stop Dess from watching music videos.

But what else is interesting, is how this song is a callback to the Undertale OST, which is sure to hit harder for original fans who grew up playing Undertale. It invokes that specific oddly sad feeling of finding your old CRT TV and VHS player sitting out in the garage, in an old forgotten and dusty corner, and recalling long ago memories that have been sitting in your own brain covered in just as much dust as the old TV is.

Toby continues to blow my mind with how easily he tells stories and evokes very specific feelings like this through music alone.

Its 1:32 A.M. on a cool May night. You can't sleep. And how could you? You graduate high school tomorrow, shouldn’t you be excited?

You are, but you're also scared. Your whole life as you know it is about to be uprooted forever. You're moving out of state for university; your friends to soon become distant memories, although you don't know that yet. Your dog is getting old... so are your parents for that matter.

But right now, you're outside, in your backyard, earbuds in, just thinking. Reminiscing on your childhood, how fast it truly went by. Your friend wasn't lying, senior year does go by fast.

You still miss her, the one that got away. You still see her in the halls every now and then, but you've accepted shes no longer in your life. A tear falls slowly down your cheek. You're scared to be without her, even though you two haven't talked in over a year.

stories.author: @commpisto5948
stories.text:
A lot of people say that Chapter 4 was the turning point of the game becoming more serious. But I think it began in chapter 3. We are seeing a dude traumatised by your family drama, whom everyone left and who can no longer fulfil his one purpose. When faced with rejection from the kid who watched him from the very start, he undergoes a manic episode to try to get hold of something from the past. He pushes too far, and loses his employees, his set, his own world turns to stone when he realises he no longer belongs in the Dreemurr household. He is completely alone, even Mike, the shared friend with his ex, leaves him. Snow comes from the open door and freezes his green room. The show is over and he cannot pretend anymore. 

He stands outside, as the three heroes come in to tell him once more that he is obselete. Even after he is defeated, Ralsei reminds him that (not cool Ralsei!).

And then Susie comes and talks to him. For the first time, he has hope that things will change for the better, that he can make someone happy again. He gives up all malicious intentions he may have had, completely relinquishes any agreements he had with the Knight. He gives them Toriel willingly.

And then, just as he is celebrating that everything is going to be okay, he is killed. Remember that if you don't recruit enough people, Susie can't fix him. He stays dead. He did not flee like Darkner enemies usually do. He was not even frozen like in Snowgrave. He was dismembered and dropped from a cliff. All his hopes and dreams were ended by the Knight.

I genuinely believe that Chapter 3's ending is darker than anything we've  seen in Chapter 4. Not to mention Undyne.

"i never had time or interest in TV time, since our TV didn't have your show for some reason."
"heh... it reminds me of a certain modernist scoundrel with a god complex and who hates the radio."
"but the point is... i recognized i had overdone the killjoy emo child act, and to compensate, put on the stark opposite during my edgy speech."
"that what edgy means? you know. when something's pretentious and trying hard to sound dangerous and intimidating, but it fails — it just comes out as what it really is — pretentious."
"no! of course not! you're not edgy. you're not pretentious."
"don't take my emo shit to heart... i was a bit of an idiot when i put on the act. repressing my interests was... a pretty dickish approach to be real."
"but point is, you know. i recognized my rudeness and desperately tried to compensate with fanaticism. down to the merch and all that. pretending i knew the very date of creation of that one red wire on your neck board."
"i overcompensated, though..."
"even if you wanna deny it... we both knew it wasn't real passion."
"just my sick way of saying "sorry, don't leave me behind, nor yell at me while you're at it."

stories.author: @Necyar
stories.text:
This theme of being forgotten in this chapter. Your home, the place you visit the most, is, surprisingly, the place you forget the most. It is its clean, shining, vibrant exterior, that is ready to serve you, is what you call your home, your familiar group of items, that you use the most, that you clean the most, that you think about the most, always on the places familiar to you, comfortable for you, always for you to see. And you believe your home is clean, is organized, nothing lost, everything important in the right places.
And that goes for years, and for years, those other items beneath the shiny exterior, somewhere in a dark cabinet, in which you rarely, briefly look inside, collect the dust, forgotten, abandoned, placed by you just far enough, in a place, where you won't see them. And for years you don't remember them, there are more important things on your mind than them. And so they sit there for many countless years, in darkness, in filth and dust, only to be found one day and thrown in the trash. They were once wanted, weren't they? They were once needed, when they were brought into this house, fresh, shining, ready to serve, to happily do their duty, they had a purpose. They were remembered by you, you needed them. Then, one day, you didn't show up for them, same happened the next day, and then next week, and next month, and next year... You left them there without a warning, without stating why, you forgot about them. And then, after many years, you threw them out of the only place, they knew as their home, like a piece of garbage, so that they wither or get grinded somewhere you won't see, somewhere away from your... Home. Must it be like this, what did they do wrong and others didn't, is it truly fair, is it truly fair, that some of them stay shining for years, and others lay forgotten somewhere deep, isolated from others, devoid of other's sight? Was it the importance of another or did you aid yourself with a _thought_ that you do not need them, in order to forget them? 
How terrifying it is, if it's so easy to forget an item so close to you and not to remember it for years, how easy it is to forget something else? Or someone else? Someone, who was once needed and wanted, now slowly wilting somewhere, somewhere where others don't look and don't listen, gathering dust and filth in both body and soul, forgotten, abandoned, while another is shining and is remembered by thousands? How many examples are out there? We will never know, as no one remembers them, no one will miss them, when they will disappear, no one will give them a flower, no one will visit their grave, like they never existed throughout all these years, like everyone agreed to purposefully ignore them, as if holding a grudge. Must it be like this, what did they do wrong, that others didn't, is this truly fair, is this truly fair, that we are all born the same, yet choose to separate ourselves like this?

in chapter 1, if you keep flushing the toilet, Toriel asks if you put another bath bomb in it.

Kris probably used the tv to distract themselves when the arguments were too unbearable... and that must've rubbed onto Tenna.

stories.author: @spoonsrattling
stories.text: This point makes no sense to me. It would be very OUT of character for toby to just wrap up the story in chapter 5. Undertale plays its cards very close to its chest, as has deltarune, and truthfully there isnt that much ground to cover. Every question traces back to the incident and the bunker, which chapter 5 reinforced, even the plot around that is directly linked to that, the secret bosses all have ties to the shadowy puppet masters running the show here. Pulling back the curtain on good ole wing dings would leave room for a metal gear ass conversation as the story reaches its climax, because truthfully deltarune is a puzzle with only a few integral parts missing. In truth i think two chapters is arguably too much time, and thats why i think were getting chapters 6+7 together, the final egg and last shadow crystal in chapter 5 reinforces that for me. stories.author: @toupster0
stories.text:
We're not supposed to win this fight and in getting the shadow crystal/shadow mantle for chapter 3, I think it's going to cause something...bad to happen down the line.

The line with toriel changes from dream to knightmare, the line of dialogue when fighting tenna changes, we discard a lot of characters in the 8bit game to get the mantle and the fight itself with the mantle and the KNIGHT is... Monstrously tough compared to Jevil, Spamton and then Gerson. 

Gerson in particular feels like a step back in difficulty after the KNIGHT, no doubt intentional.

...

So then why, and what will happen next?

...

When looking at the updated spamton sweepstakes people saw a page that showed each chapter in different sized fonts and a sound played as you clicked each one. Chapter 2 played the snowgrave berdly theme, so everyone assumes it's a snowgrave guide. 2,4 and 5 each appear white with different sizes, 2 being biggest, 4 being the smallest and 5 somewhere in the middle.

Chapter 3 and 1 however are not immediately visible and on highlighting it shows the same text size as chapter 2 for chapter 3! Chapter 1 is tiny and almost non existent. On clicking chapter 3 it plays the mantle sound, and as we know

"If only you had the [MANTLE SFX], your luck might have gone another way.
No [MANTLE SFX]...no crystal."

...as another quote on a seperate sweepstakes page reminds us.


Perhaps these pages aren't a sign of the weird route, but more a way to throw the game off track and do something you're not supposed to do.

Diving further into the pages, you can change the chapter number in the url to find other pages for chapters. Chapter 1 says "Not Applicable.", Chapter 2 says " Applicable." But chapter 3 says "Not Applicable. But..."

...

BUT WHAT?!

As chapter 2 and 3 are the same size on this sweepstakes page, that means that the change we can make in chapter 3 will have AS BIG AN IMPACT on the game as chapter 2. Just not... For the weird route.

We've all made the assumption that there will only be 5 shadow crystals, but what if we're wrong? What if there's 6? Not only alleviating the pain of a... Particular boss you find difficult but something else that might happen if you get more than you really need?

SOMETHING VERY VERY INTERESTING.

We can guess where the snowgrave route will go but this possible... "route" ...we have no idea!

...

...and that thought terrifies me.

stories.author: @potatojuiceultra
stories.text:
First of all, this song captures the vibe of a retro Zelda theme PERFECTLY, if you told me this was from one of the gameboy games that I haven't played yet I'd have 100% believed you.
Second of all, its interesting that we have an actual hint toward the weird route now. The first game requires you to kill every enemy to grow stronger and break the game, calling back to Undertale genocide (which new deltarune players should be familiar with since you're supposed to play undertale first). The second has you follow the white cloaked figure and have her freeze enemies, the symbolism is pretty clear here and it directly mentions a "forbidden route".
This brings up two points:
1. Toby wants us to find the weird route. It hasn't been mentioned in game or in any official material, until now. This isn't just meant for dataminers, it is just as much a part of the game as genocide in undertale.
2. WHAT DOES THE THIRD GAME FORESHADOW??????? There's still a few hints here, the weird route starts in the city, spamton is a big part of the route, you have to harm your friends. But unlike the first two where I can explain all of the symbolism with a pretty good amount of confidence, I have no idea what is going on for most of this section. Why do we go down the manhole, why do we kill Tenna, why do we go in the bunker, who do we fight in the bunker, why do they tease Kris and summon FRIENDs as minions, why does game Kris go out of the screen and threaten real Kris, what is going on????? If the pattern continues, everything that happens here should end up as very direct symbolism for things that happen in the story. So its more than a little unsettling that I have so much potential foreshadowing and no idea what to make of it.

stories.author: @MrFree2424
stories.text:
God damn this is such a banger. The composition of this really drives home the feeling of the resolute hero on an adventure to save those close to them, just like in Zelda. It's so monumentally successful at this that I genuinely like this section of chapter three over the normal game boards. Where as the normal boards playing with Susie and Ralsei make the player nostalgic for the feeling of playing console games with your friends/parents/others back in the day--the same feeling of bonds and connections between the actual characters themselves--THIS section makes the player nostalgic for the actual game itself. One is a love letter to the bonds gaming creates, and the other is a love letter to the feelings games create. And I think this music is the main key to that feeling, making me love even more.

Which is all the more disturbing when you realize the music is leading you into a false sense of security, and you forget you're killing innocent people.

Fuck, Toby. You didn't have to go this hard. Keep up the amazing work--I genuinely can't wait to see what happens next.

stories.author: @bonni2920
stories.text:
The cross shaped maze in the ice area from Dragon Blazers. Once you go in it, no matter where you go, you'll always be brought back to the same room.

Normally one of the characters is supposed to guide you through the maze. But it became one of the most famous (or should I say infamous... XP) parts of the game because if you go there without that character, you'll get basically stuck... FOREVER.

The developers actually say something about this in the manual… It warns you this glitch is actually "one of the bad guy's magic spells"… Yeah XD... Sorry guys, I think you were just eating a little too much fruitcake when making this part of the game. XP

As a kid I had no idea that this was a glitch XD I literally spent hours on the screen wandering around thinking there was an exit!!

 

The thing is, there actually is one.

Somehow kid me was so stubborn, I think I went EVERY single possible direction somehow XD Then the last direction you go is up.

If you do that, you'll find a door that doesn't appear ANYWHERE else in the game.

This shocked me so much as a kid I screamed and pulled my controller so hard it unplugged the console XD I actually started crying… but I knew my mom would turn off the game if she heard me, so I held my breath and started hiccuping and gasping. I literally thought I was going to choke on my tears. It only made me cry more that I had to plug the game back in by myself. I was so scared that I would get electrocuted and die from the wires. I was actually always afraid of electrical sockets too because I thought they were looking at me XD (Come on I wasn't a weird kid I promise... XP I got over it after that)

So I started the game again, and with my hands shaking I went back into the maze.

But what's super weird, was that somehow, I was able to get RIGHT back to the door.

I was so happy I almosted started screaming again, but remembered to hold my breath halfway XD Now I was going to be able to see what was in the secret door…

Or so I thought XP It was locked. And I've never been able to find ANY key in the game that opens it.

Since then, I can actually get to the door pretty consistently if I concentrate.

Unfortunately I don't know exactly what I'm doing, and it feels different every time, so I can't give any advice XD

stories.author: @SlimeWizaaard
stories.text:
I didn’t grow up in the 80s but my dad did, and he loved the original Zelda. And when I was around 9 my dad and step mom got one of those unofficial consoles that could play old games. With it they got Mario 1 and 2, Zelda 1 and 2, and a few other games. I think they played Zelda 1 the most, I did to and even got through the first dungeon by myself, but mostly I would watch them play. And one of my core memories with that was when my parents would get stuck trying to get through a dungeon and listening to the constantly looping dungeon music. It was almost hypnotic, and I would lose myself in the mournful digitized refrains. Until I could separate the layers of the song and focus on each one, until the song began to change in my head even though I knew it was the same, until it gave me a headache and I had to leave the room.

This song brought back those memories. I don’t even know if I registered it but I found myself entering that same state, that same trance as I did when I was 9. Amplified tenfold by the haunting context of where I was, of what I had to do. Of what I knew this represented. Tricky Tony is truly a master of his craft.

stories.author: @TheRealRELSAY
stories.text:
The two vessels sat- overlooking the vast, pixelated ocean. WHITE CLOAK glanced to her partner, HEROSWORD. 

They noticed her staring, and gave an affirmative nod, before reaching for their drink. 

They idly sipped, the waves crashing against the shoreline of their private hell. 

WHITE CLOAK simply held her own drink in her hands, miserably looking at her umpteenth cup of hot chocolate. Well, more like tepid chocolate, as her natural freezing touch made any beverage she held gradually chilled. 

Despite being given a respite from the SOUL forcing the pair onward, both knew that such pleasantries were rare and fleeting. 

The only thing that -Noelle- WHITE CLOAK remotely found positive about recovering the SOULS [redacted] was that she at least got to reconnect with -Kris- HEROSWORD. When they both weren’t being possessed and forced to kill darkners that is. 

She could only wonder if her awfully-wedded partner felt anything similar, as she could have sworn that she saw them looking over to her veiled face a few times and blushing ever so slightly. The thought warmed -Noelle- WHITE CLOAK, but only a little. 


Either way, they would be spending much more time with the other whether they truly wanted it this way or not. Why -Kris- HEROSWORD had dragged her all the way out to the beach made little sense in her frazzled mind, as it wasn’t like the SOUL couldn’t just rip them back to the edge of the next gameboard whenever it felt like it.
She had a shadow of a feeling that -Kris- felt similarly about the fake beach, and was only trying to do… anything different, to break up the usual monotony of… well. 

 
Why would it matter where they waited, when any semblance of leisure was shallow at best. Sooner or later… the SOUL would grow restless, dragging them both to angel knows where- their entire physical forms nothing but pieces on a wall for the parasite to pick at. 

…

Anyways, the beach, devoid of life as it was, offered only the faintest veneer of familiarity in her eyes- she was quite certain that -Kris- HEROSWORD could recall quite vividly memories of visiting the actual town beach with her, Azzy, and [REDACTED]. Oh how messily they all played, yet she still cherished their time nonetheless. Such fond memories only heightened how unbearably _false_ the current location felt. The beach -Kris- HEROSWORD had stopped them at was nothing more than a shallow imitation, and it made little difference. Soon, the SOUL would come for them both, and they would start up their now-routine song and dance. Ugh, if [REDACTED] heard how snobbish she was acting right now, she’d probably yell at them both.. she appreciated the gesture, she really did. It’s the thought that counts right? That’s what her father always told her whenever her mo- Carol would say she wasn’t putting 100% into her coloring homework. 
Compared to the lovely little excursion she was on now, watching her parents argue sounded goddamned serene. 


When did she become so cynical? It’s not like she was forced to be- wait, that isn’t true, LOL. “Like hell I was…” the hooded figure murmured to herself. There was no desire to paint this “adventure” as anything more than a twisted game of playing house. Still, the fact that she found herself being so… bitter about the whole situation still gave her a split second of pause- she really had become a new person hadn’t she? Or had the real her woken up? 

….


“What is even real at this point?”


-Kris- HEROSWORD said out loud. 

She glanced to them, their partner staring off into the blackened sky above as if they themselves had heard the question in her head. -Noelle- WHITE CLOAK thought upon their -friend- -lover- partner’s query for a moment, then whispered out her verdict. 

“I like to pretend that the connection we have is still real. It’s the only thing either of us get to keep after… everything we did…”

The beach. So wonderful. If she only had a camera. Tenna’s board had a camera, but no. The SOUL decided to throw the normal, happy, and safe game away so they could taste something _original._ 

“How f*cking quaint”, -Noelle- WHITE CLOAK dryly chuckled. 

She turned to look at her partner again, and HEROSWORD fidgeted in their seat. Then, unexpectedly, they leaned towards her and whispered into her ear. 


….


_“I’m sorry, __-Noelle.-__ “_



She sighed and gave them the most pathetically sad smile she’s ever given anyone (minus that one annoying classmate, what was his name again?)  though she doubted they could see her facial expression through the hood. What could they possibly be sorry for? It’s not like she was trying to fight back anymore, neither of them really were. Any and all pretenses of getting stronger had froze over and died several routes ago, they were pretty much just being using one another as dolls at this point. Compatible dolls, to be certain, but puppets forcibly embraced on the same red string. The worst part? She would be lying if she said she didn’t get a perverse thrill out of it. Making the _other_ person cower. Making the _other_ person cry. However -Kris- HEROSWORD felt about their wintery “joyride” was relative, as however bitter  might have been before, at least they didn’t have to suffer alone. She hoped Kris was having fun, at least a little. Surely doing all this, as beyond insanity it was… 

…Wasn’t it nice to reconnect again? 


Honestly, why should her childhood friend beat themselves up, even now? So they couldn’t protect her from that…. floating red…. thing.  At least they were on the same page now, and maybe now everyone would stop seeing her as just some victim to smother with “protection”.  She honestly hoped -Kris- HEROSWORD wasn’t still hung up about the incident on the couch, now that she understood the true nature of the SOUL, she firmly believed that it was only a matter of time that she was summoned as the “bride” to her long-suffering “groom.” As scary as it was, when did she never not like scary? Whether it be from them, Catti, [REDACTED], or… 

….Su- What was she talking about? Oh yes, her partner’s guilt. She didn’t resent them at all for it, not in the slightest. If anything, shouldn’t -Kris- be happier? They get to have her all to themselves, and now that they’ve both been ensnared, realistically they have nothing left to lose. Yes, -Kris- all to herself… though neither of them hardly felt like a prize… She glanced towards them again, -Kris- now slumped over in their beach chair with both hands covering the bottom of their face. Their piercing ruby eyes staring into nothingness, for what felt like a short eternity.

As fun as this “date” was…. she needed her “hero” with their head in the game, not in pixel clouds. She gently took her “partner” by their hand in her own, the thornring gripping into their palm. They winced at this, but made no effort to remove their hand. Apart of her wanted them to feel the sting, apart of her WANTED them to have even feel a fraction of the dull agony her hand feels every second of every day she spends wearing the stupid ring. -Kris- idly rubbed her thorny band with their index finger, almost in a perverse reverence. 
Must like the acute pains now, huh Kris? 
Her childhood friend, tormentor, and now “lover” a ruined masochist. 


Just like her. Some “good influence” she turned out to be. Surely, her [REDACTED] would be proud at how much of a “rebel” she was being. All it took was both her and her “protector” doing everything the damned parasite demanded, down to the last frosted letter. 


Before she could get another thought out, a bright flash of red light pierced the sky, followed by the unmistakable sound of the SOUL reconnecting into the game console. 


They both shuddered involuntarily, before straightening themselves out of their recliner chairs. 

HEROSWORD smiled miserably at her, before taking one final sip of their pixelated beverage. 

As she adjusted her ring, she saw the pulsating red terror slowly floating over to where they were on the ocean shore. The damned thing might as well have had a GPS shoved into it. 


Bracing themselves, they took each other’s arms in a twisted embrace, hugging each other one last time before they both went under. 

The SOUL was nearly on them now, the dark fountain on the horizon roaring at them, as if to say it had waited long enough. The dark fountain could wait apparently, as the SOUL had nothing better to do than “play house” with the two of them. 

The frigid waves crashed down upon the shore as if Heaven itself was raging at their sinful union. 

A massive whoosh was heard, as the Soul descended downward to yank them back up into the darkened heavens. It did *not* look happy, to say the least. HEROSWORD, sensing the impending takeover, closed their eyes, and took WHITECLOAK’S  hand tightly in theirs as they hugged. 



….




Leaning in, *Kris* whispered their final thought into *Noelle’s* ear. 

“If this is is ever over…. we need a real vacation.” 

*Noelle* could only smile though her shrouded cloak. “You’re buying the drinks then, Krismas.”

stories.author: @FelisDeNox
stories.text:
This is my favourite track of the game.


The way it's written, the way it fits in the secret game, the way the melody is made of repeating notes, only changing note order or octaves...
It makes me feel anxious. Dreadful. It reminds me of when I was a child, exploring bits on the internet I shouldn't be on. Seeing things I never imagined existed, things I wasn't supposed to know or see, at least not yet.
But it also feels like entrapment. The notes that keep repeating, it's like a loop, something you can never escape, which fits with the dungeon this theme plays on. The walls, the enemies, it makes you feel stuck. Like a prophecy. There is no way to change it or destroy it: your fate is written, and just now you realize that. That you never had a choice. That you're helpless. That you're just a pawn of time and space.
But, it also seems... strangely hopeful? The octaves shift from a lower to a higher pitch. Whoever showed you what you weren't supposed to see; your fate, is also showing a way to 'escape' it. To change it. Showing you another path.
Lastly, it has a ever so subtle hint of curiosity. A part of you is anxious about playing fate, but another part is looking forward to it. "What would happen if I...?". The question lingers in your mind, tempting you to proceed.
You don't know much about this "alternate" path you just found out. Nor what will happen if you try to cheat the prophecy. But one thing you know:

*The forbidden path began with ice magic.*

stories.author: @PetikG
stories.text:
For a side-quest that's advertised as Kris having fun playing games just as they remember, this is the most unsettling part of the chapter by far.

You are standing all by yourself in an unlit room, playing a game where you progress by killing several enemies, while once again being faced with the tough question of whether you are doing the right thing. Next you do what's told in many classic video game creepypastas and break out of bounds into an endless sea of palm trees.
Speaking of endless, the glacier's maze feels exactly like that. Like wherever you go doesn't matter and always leads back to the same spot. Accompany that with many hints to chapter 2's alternate route and with perhaps the most haunting chiptune track I've heard lately, the glacier maze makes you want to escape as soon as possible.

And even Kris themself is unnerved by this. You can tell by the moments when they flinch, or look away. Such as when you have to kill the two other party members in the game, or when you're approaching the dreaded shelter and they briefly refuse to come closer. Or when they step back once the game's character break the fourth wall.

As if that wasn't enough, when Susie arrives and you tell her you are having fun playing the game, she tells you not to be a tryhard by yourself, otherwise you'll end up like Berdly. Which does not sound so bad, if you don't discover it on the "weird route".

stories.author: @DementedDuskull
stories.text:
My two scents (*they smell like freshly rained grass and spicy pickled peppers...): The mysterious entity who drove both Jevil and Spamton crazy is the one who holds the ShadowMantle, who we'll just call Eram for convenience. We do not know their name; many thought it was Mike for a while, but that was a red herring. Eram talks to us for the first time HERE, which is huge, as they have largely hid in the shadows up until now, no pun intended. They seem to be connected to the cat-like, yellow and pink-eyed shadowy entity from Ralsei's story at the start of Chapter 3, and by extension the secret smiling yellow and pink-eyed face in Queen's Mansion Basement in Chapter 2, and the similar cat-like yellow and pink-eyed minions that the Shadow Mantle boss summons during the fight. So we _kind of_ know what they look like, but they are still shrouded in mystery. The way they're being set up reads almost as if they're some kind of god or ghostly being that haunts the Dark World as the metaphysical embodiment of shadow, "the fallen star, creating rivers from its tears". They made the Shadow Crystals (and the BitterTear item too, I guess), and then hid them around the Dark World for unknown purposes. 
They hid one in Card Castle, which Jevil already found. With the knowledge and power it brought, he correctly foretold to King that he would rise to power in The Knight's name, until Seam tricked Jevil into a cage and fled.
They hid another in the broken machine in Queen's Mansion Basement, and we even saw their face there as if they were watching and waiting for someone to grab it, which Spamton eventually does, to their delight.
The Roaring Knight already has a Shadow Crystal, which it could have obtained from TV World, but also possibly the Dark World in the Shelter. If not from TV World, then Eram's main meddling there is the hiding of the Shadow Mantle, meant specifically for Kris, who created this Dark World. When The Knight is beaten, a small shard is taken off of their blade. I'm reasonably sure this is supposed to represent the BlackShard weapon, not the Shadow Crystal, even though it says you picked up the Shadow Crystal first. Is The Knight's blade MADE of Shadow Crystals...? We don't know.
And finally, a Shadow Crystal was placed in the desk in The Old Man's study, clearly because Eram wanted him to find it, but The Old Man wasn't interested in a prophecy that looks the same from every angle, and didn't use it.
Seam implies there are only five Shadow Crystals, or at least only five that they know about. Overall, the character's actions and motives are greatly shrouded in mystery. Spamton makes me want to believe they're secretly a Lightner because of the garbage noise on the phone, but the amount of sway and control they have over reality in the Dark World has me wondering otherwise...

I don't remember when, but during a town segment in chapter 3 or 4, Susie mentions that she hears music across the lake.

Another point about Dess not being the Knight is that, if she's actually deceased, and resurrected as the knight, why isn't Gerson just like her, a shadow entity of who he once was? Food for thought.

I could be wrong, but who knows. It's just a theory.

Thinking of playing this game again some time. I was extremely excited for new chapters. Before one week of this game's release date, I hurried and finished the first two chapters to freshen my memory of the story and the game. Then when the chapter came out, I downloaded the game but didn't do anything for some time. I stopped browsing Deltarune content in social medias to prevent spoilers. But I liked the creator did experimented with the game and gave something new like that game inside game thing. I liked the ending of that chapter. 

I immediately started Chapter 4 to continue the story, I was at the edge of my seat. I played for 1-2 hours. Then, I waited till tomorrow and played for some time again. But I was itching to play more but I couldn't, since I didn't have time to play it for myself. So I opened YouTube and just started watching spoilers because I wanted to know what happens next in the story. It was amazing experience, Chapter 4 blew my mind. The final boss fight was really really cool. I like the friendship of Kris and Susie. 

I kinda stopped after that, I stopped loving playing games. It just didn't hit the same anymore, Deltarune reignited the flame but the flame didn't last long. I didn't bother to replay the game and find new secrets and contents. I have all the secret bosses, dialogues to encounter myself. It seems like I didn't do justice to this game. I have some very fun memories with Undertale and Deltarune (CH 1+2) games, so it really sucks that I just don't have the energy to enjoy these games like I want to.

stories.author: @dr.freenis
stories.text:
Past the tacky Christmas cheer of the holiday manor lies the truth. Dess' room. Band posters, punk cds, all the hallmarks of teen rebellion perfectly preserved as if frozen in time. You shouldn't be in here, you know you shouldn't, but you cant help it. As you lightly step around the room, carefully as to not even disturb the thin layer of dust coating everything, you notice the wiffle bat in the corner. Bent, cracked, and dented, you can't help but wonder how many of those marks are from your head? Azzy's? Noelle's? You feel a lump grow in your throat. No matter how many plastic candy canes Carol scatters around the manor grounds, it'll never fill the hole she left. This is the true face of the Holidays. Loss. Pain. Faded memories, distorted nostalgia.

sorry for the hacky creative writing. this song hit me like a swift kick in the ribs when i first heard it and i wanted to try and put those emotions out there

stories.author: @ocaradasmaoladobokunohero
stories.text: I had a hunch that this was Dess' room, but actually entering it actually made me stop for a bit. I think stories where characters are _missing_ instead of dead are more powerful. There's that... tension. The fact that you don't even know what happened, and the faint hope that one day, maybe, they'll come back. That one day you'll hear the front door opening and they'll walk back in. Knowing that something's wrong, but not having any closure... and don't even get me started on all of Dess' belongings that her family kept safely in her room. Seeing all her stuff... her guitar... rummaging through all the things she had... an unkempt bed, likely left the same way since the day she last got up from it... and with this track playing... man. It's almost like you can feel her bedroom waiting for her to come back, waiting for someone that'll never come home... just like Noelle...
